notes: Public Punjab National Bank RFP for cheque imaging scanners for the Cheque Truncation System. Retrieved 2026-10-23 from https://www.pnbindia.in/ViewTenderEauction.aspx?fileid=nj%2F7OIjGGxoe9%2BGLvDgauw%3D%3D&tenid=mELirpUhRYksFj7k8%2FXBcQ%3D%3D&type=Tender. The document schedule dates the procurement to April 2017; treat it as an archived real tender, not a current opportunity. EMD varies by grid selection, so no single EMD value is recorded in fields.

fields.tender_title: Supply, Installation, Configuration, Testing, Commissioning and Maintenance of Cheque Imaging Scanners for Cheque Truncation System

minimum_turnover.raw: Rs. 5 crores each during the last two financial year 2014-15 and 2015-16

questions.query: What equipment and service is PNB seeking in this procurement?
questions.gold_span: Request for Proposal for Supply, Installation, Configuration, Testing, Commissioning and Maintenance of Cheque imaging scanners for Cheque Truncation System.

questions.query: When was the online bid submission due according to the bid schedule?
questions.gold_span: Last date and time for online Bid submission 26.04.2017 till 1400 HRS

questions.query: What bid security amount applies to each combination of CTS grids?
questions.gold_span: A) Northern and Southern Grids - Rs.4,00,000/- (Rs. Four Lakhs only) B) Western Grid only- Rs.1,00,000/- (Rs. One Lakh only) C) Northern, Southern and Western Grids - Rs.5,00,000/- (Rs. Five Lakhs only)

questions.query: What annual turnover did the bidder need to show for the two specified financial years?
questions.gold_span: The bidder should have minimum annual turnover of Rs. 5 crores each during the last two financial year 2014-15 and 2015-16.

questions.query: For how long must the supplier support the scanners with spare parts after installation?
questions.gold_span: Bidder should undertake to provide maintenance support to equipment and arrange for spare parts for a minimum period of Five years from the date of installation.
